title: The School Play
description: Children practise and perform a play at school.
instructions: Read about the school play. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🎭 Every year, Class 5 does a play for the whole school. This year, the play is called 'The Dragon and the Princess'. Mrs Green, the English teacher, chose it because it is funny.
Minh wanted to be the dragon, but Tom got the part. Minh was a little sad. Then Mrs Green said, 'Minh, you can be the king. The king has the most words to say!' Minh smiled again.
The children practised after school every Tuesday and Thursday. Anna, who plays the princess, forgot her words many times. 'Don't worry,' said Mrs Green. 'You should read them again at home.'
Hoa and Ben made the costumes. Hoa's mum, who is a tailor, helped them to sew a big green dragon suit. It had two long wings and a tail, which was almost two metres long.
On Friday, there was a problem. Tom was ill and he couldn't come to school. The children were worried. 'Maybe we can't do the play,' said Anna. Nobody knew what to do.
Then Ben had an idea. 'I watched every practice, so I know the dragon's words,' he said. 'I could play the dragon if Tom doesn't get better.' Mrs Green was happy and said he was very kind.
At seven o'clock, the hall was full. Ben put on the dragon suit and walked on to the stage. His legs were shaking, but he spoke clearly. Everybody laughed when the dragon sneezed.
After the play, the audience clapped for a long time. Tom came to watch with his mum, and he shouted, 'Well done, Ben!' Next year, they are going to do a play about pirates.
